# TigreGótico

> FOSS AI and voice technology specialists. We build privacy-first voice
> assistants, custom TTS models, and web applications, and we are core
> maintainers of the OpenVoiceOS and HiveMind stack.

## Core Information
- [Home](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/): Overview of services, featured projects, and latest updates.
- [About](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/about): The team, our mission in open-source voice tech, and our role in the OpenVoiceOS ecosystem.
- [Services](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/services): FOSS voice tech and AI consulting, custom TTS training, OpenVoiceOS integration, and privacy-focused web development.
- [Products](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/products): OpenVoiceOS plugins and official OVOS merchandise.
- [Contact](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/contact): Inquiries, consulting requests, and collaboration.

## Projects & Resources
- [Projects](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/projects): Open-source contributions and partnerships.
- [Blog](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/blog): Articles on voice AI, OpenVoiceOS development, and synthetic data.
- [Resources](https://tigregotico.github.io/tigregotico-website/resources): Datasets, models, notebooks, and research.

## External Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/TigreGotico): Open-source repositories.
- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/TigreGotico): AI models and datasets.
- [OpenVoiceOS](https://openvoiceos.org): The open-source voice platform we maintain.
